about_the_game:
Speak of The Crown is a voice-controlled, top-down real-time strategy (RTS) game where your words command the battlefield. As the leader of a small but powerful fantasy army, you’ll issue vocal orders to control units, capture objectives, and outmaneuver enemies in tactical single-player missions. Speak clearly, act swiftly, and lead your forces to victory—all without touching a button.

This is not just a strategy game—this is a test of your leadership and clarity under pressure. Designed with immersive voice interaction at its core, Speak of The Crown challenges you to think like a commander and speak like a leader.

Key Features:

  • Voice Command Gameplay – Control your army entirely through speech. Issue orders like “All archers advance” or “Send cavalry north” and watch your strategy unfold.

  • Fantasy Setting – Command knights, archers, mages, and more in a world of magic, strategy, and combat.

  • Tactical Depth – Plan flanks, hold choke points, and manage your forces in dynamic real-time encounters.

  • Playable Levels – Conquer handcrafted missions, each with unique objectives and challenges.

  • Immersive Experience – Feel like a true battlefield commander with a game built from the ground up for vocal interaction.

  • Single-Player Focused – No distractions—just you, your army, and the art of war.

Whether you're a strategy veteran or just looking for something totally new, Speak of The Crown delivers a fresh, hands-free take on tactical combat. Raise your voice—and let it lead the charge.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Mojave 10.14 or later for Intel Macs. macOS Big Sur 11.0 or later for Apple Silicon Macs.
  • Processor: both
  • Graphics: At least 2GB VRAM recommended.
  • Sound Card: Basic audio output/input capability required. Support for 16kHz audio sampling rate required. Built-in audio on Mac should be sufficient.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Mojave 10.14 or later for Intel Macs. macOS Big Sur 11.0 or later for Apple Silicon Macs.
  • Processor: both
  • Graphics: At least 5GB-10GB VRAM recommended.
  • Sound Card: Basic audio output/input capability required. Support for 16kHz audio sampling rate required. Built-in audio on Mac should be sufficient.
